VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: shrine
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Shrine — the cursed technique of the King of Curses, recovered by those who consume his remains. Its slashes are precise, invisible and indifferent; they adjust themselves to whatever is put in front of them.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Twenty fingers were sealed, and every one of them still holds him. A sorcerer who swallows one inherits a piece of a technique that was never meant to be shared — and gives up a piece of themselves in exchange. The more of him you take, the less of you decides what happens next.
